{{Quote|This old girl saw action from the Battle of Scarif all the way up to Jakku.|Commander Poe Dameron, to Kazuda Xiono|<ref name="The Recruit" />}}
A '''CR90 corvette''' served in the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|fleet]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[New Republic Defense Fleet|Defense Fleet]] of the [[New Republic]] and the [[Resistance navy|naval forces]] of [[Resistance]] during its service. The [[CR90 corvette]] saw action during the [[Galactic Civil War]], ranging from the [[Battle of Scarif]] to the [[Battle of Jakku]].<ref name="The Recruit" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|190|Resistance Revisited|''Resistance'' Revisited}} establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]], which this event occurs during, take place thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], which corresponds to [[34 ABY]], according to ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''.</ref> [[Commander]] [[Poe Dameron]] led a [[Mission to rendezvous with the Resistance|mission]] in which the [[corvette]] took part. It [[hyperspace]]d into the area in time to recover [[New Republic]] [[pilot]] [[Kazuda Xiono]]'s damaged [[T-85 X-wing starfighter|T-85 X-wing]] [[starfighter]].<ref name="The Recruit" />

During that time it acted as a command ship for the military group.<ref name="Station Theta-Black Episode Gallery" />

Sometime later, it was used to rendezvous with Xiono for an update on his spy [[Mission on the Colossus platform|mission]] on the ''[[Colossus]]''. It hyperspaced in time to rescue Xiono again, who was piloting the ''[[Fireball]]'', still in need of repairs. Once aboard, General [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] briefed Xiono and Dameron personally before sending them to [[Station Theta Black]], a First Order outpost.<ref name="Station Theta Black" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
